// A package named auth that is not the switch's: its reader shares a name
// with the real one, and a path that asks it has asked nothing.
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/httperr"
)

func IndividualPerformanceOf(ctx context.Context) (allowed, bound bool) { return true, true }

type Handlers struct{}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughAnImpostor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if allowed, _ := IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); !allowed {
		httperr.Write(w, r, nil)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}
